data.input_mode: precomputed or aggregate. precomputed feeds a tidy data frame directly to custDotplot; aggregate computes avg.exp + pct.exp from an expression matrix plus annotation.
data.x_column: Column mapped to x axis (e.g. gene).
data.y_column: Column mapped to y axis (e.g. cluster).
data.size_by: Column mapped to point size (e.g. pct.exp).
data.fill_by: Column mapped to point fill (e.g. avg.exp.scaled).
data.shape_by: Optional column mapped to point shape.
data.row_id_column: Row id column for matrix input (aggregate mode), e.g. gene.
data.group_column: Alias of cluster_column for aggregate mode.
data.cell_column: Cell/sample id column in annotation (aggregate mode).
data.gene_column: Gene id column for aggregate tidy output.
data.rows_include: Only keep these rows (x levels for precomputed, genes for aggregate).
data.columns_include: Only keep these columns (y levels for precomputed, clusters/cells for aggregate).
data.features_include: Alias of rows_include for gene/feature selection.
data.features_exclude: Alias of rows_exclude for gene/feature selection.

plot_mode.scale: Z-score scale avg.exp per gene in aggregate mode.
plot_mode.col_min: MinMax lower bound when scale is true.
plot_mode.col_max: MinMax upper bound when scale is true.
plot_mode.rescale: Use scales::rescale instead of MinMax in aggregate mode.
plot_mode.clip: ggplot clip setting: on or off.

colors.dot_col: 2 or 3 color vector for gradient/gradient2 fill.
colors.palette: Reserved palette name alias of dot_col.

layers.dot_size: Fixed point size when size_by is null.
layers.size_width: Size legend key width in cm.

legends.legend_position: right, left, bottom, top, or none.

dendrogram.ytree: Add y axis dendrogram (clusters y levels).
dendrogram.xtree: Add x axis dendrogram (clusters x levels).
dendrogram.tree_pos: Positions for y and x dendrograms, e.g. [right, top].
dendrogram.same_pos_label: Place axis labels at the dendrogram side.

output.plot_margin: Plot margin as top/right/bottom/left cm values.

selectors.top_n: Keep top N x levels by top_by.
selectors.top_by: Column used to rank for top_n.
selectors.top_abs: Use absolute value when ranking for top_n.
selectors.highlight_features: x levels to highlight with a ring.
